description: A narrow upper building rises above a wider ground-floor block with a central arched entrance. Six short vertical windows form two rows on the upper facade, and a baseline extends beyond both sides.
A tall rectangular office building has an overhanging roof ledge and a smaller raised block on top. Four narrow windows sit in pairs above a central arched doorway and a broad baseline.
A desk has a flat top, an open space on the left, and a tall drawer pedestal on the right. An arched-back chair stands centrally in front, with horizontal back and seat divisions.
A straight-legged table spans a centrally placed chair with a high rounded back. The broad chair seat sits below the tabletop, with a small curved back support and two splayed legs.
A broad desk has a shallow rounded front edge supported by two outer legs. A chair sits beneath it, with a small rounded seat, splayed legs, and an arched back visible above.
Three desktop monitors stand on two tables, with a pair on the wider rear desk and one on a smaller desk below. Each blank screen has a short triangular pedestal.
Two people sit side by side behind a shared tabletop beneath a hanging pendant lamp. An open laptop with a small central mark stands in front of the person on the right.
A broad trapezoidal desktop rests on two trestle supports. A lamp rises from its right edge, curving over toward the left and ending in a small downward-facing shade.
A large sloping drawing surface stands on two supports with broad feet. A small sheet lies centrally on the tilted board, and a short round-seated stool sits underneath.
A tall rectangular document envelope has a broad folded flap at the top and angled folds at the lower corners. Two round fasteners linked by a vertical string secure the central closure.
A broad raised handle with a central arch sits over a shallow trapezoidal base. Two short punch posts descend from the handle, while a horizontal seam separates the base's lower edge.
A symmetrical balance stands on a stepped base beneath a tall central post with a pointed finial. Two shallow semicircular pans hang from either end of the level crossbar.
A binder clip has a broad trapezoidal clamping body and a tall looped wire handle. The handle narrows below its rounded top, spreading into two bent ends along the lower edge.
A plain desk has a long horizontal top, a single leg on the left, and a two-drawer pedestal on the right. Each drawer has a short centred horizontal pull.
A blank rectangular drawing board sits on an easel with two splayed legs and a horizontal brace. A pointed rear support projects above the board and descends toward the brace.
An upright squeeze bottle has a rounded rectangular body, a stepped collar, and a long tapered nozzle. A small blank rectangular label occupies the left side of its front.
A printer has a broad rounded body with a blank sheet rising behind it. A second page extends from the lower front slot, carrying two horizontal lines of unequal length.
An open shelving unit has two tall upright side rails joined by a pair of thick horizontal shelves. The side rails continue above the top shelf and below the lower shelf.
An upright pencil stands beside a small rectangular notepad on the right. The pencil has a rounded cap and pointed tip, while three horizontal lines descend in length across the page.
A large tape roll sits in a low horizontal dispenser with a raised block on the right. The circular roll has a central opening, and a shallow tape path extends along the base.
A circular roll of tape has a large round central opening. A short loose strip runs horizontally left from its lower edge, leaving the otherwise concentric roll visibly asymmetrical.
A water cooler stands on the left with a banded inverted bottle, small tap, and narrow base cabinet. A round-canopied plant in a small pot sits beside it on the same baseline.
A tall document tube has rounded ends, a capped top with two small marks, and long vertical ribs. A broad carrying strap loops outward to the left and reconnects near the bottom.
A front-facing person is shown from the torso up above two broad shallow curves. The parallel curves sweep upward at their ends, suggesting the curved tiers of an amphitheatre.
A sloping lectern top holds a small page marked with two lines. A curved gooseneck microphone rises from the left side, and a narrow central support descends beneath the thick front edge.
A broad angled lectern surface carries a blank sheet on the right and a tilted microphone on the left. The thick rounded front edge rests above a narrow central pedestal.
A wide low projector stands on two small feet. A large circular lens overlaps the upper-right body edge, while three short vertical ventilation slots sit on the left front panel.
A rounded printer body has a small circular control on the left and a folded-corner page rising from behind. A printed sheet with two horizontal lines emerges from the front.
A tall rectangular cabinet stands on two short feet with a single broad drawer inset across its middle. A short horizontal handle is centred on the otherwise blank drawer front.
An open bookcase has two tall side rails and a central shelf. Two unequal books stand on the upper shelf at the left, while three books occupy the lower right.
A bookcase with rounded upper corners contains two horizontal shelves. Two upright books stand together in the upper section and three stand below, with the side supports continuing as short feet.
A rectangular shredder bin stands on two small feet beneath a shallow top unit. A blank page enters the upper slot, and three narrow strips descend visibly into the front of the bin.
A tall rectangular building rises behind a low entrance block on the right. Five narrow windows mark the tower, while the annex has a broad overhanging roof and an arched doorway.
A small rectangular building has a broad rounded roof fascia that overhangs both sides. A single arched doorway stands centrally in the otherwise blank facade above the straight ground line.
A compact office building has a thick overhanging flat roof and a straight baseline. Two square windows stack on the left, beside a tall arched doorway at the lower right.
A compact building has a broad overhanging roof and three square windows, two across the top and one below left. An arched doorway occupies the lower-right part of the facade.
A low rounded holder contains an upright pen, a sharpened pencil, and scissors. The pen's pocket clip hangs at the left, while two round scissor handles rise above the crossed blades.

A shallow trapezoidal tape dispenser holds a partially exposed roll toward the right. A sloping support rises behind the left end, and the roll's small circular opening remains visible above the tray.
A tape dispenser has a rounded roll housing on the right and a tall rounded cutting support on the left. A deep curved recess separates them, with a loose tape strip extending diagonally upward left.
A small house has a pitched roof with overhanging eaves and a short chimney on the right slope. A square four-pane window sits centrally in the otherwise plain front wall.
A blank monitor stands on a shallow desktop with a slanting leg on the left. A separate office chair faces the desk from the right, with a curved back and central pedestal base.
A person raises one arm toward a wall-mounted presentation screen behind them. A short zigzag line marks the screen, whose lower-left outline is hidden by the presenter and pointing arm.
